source_snapshot.criteria: The information matches AMD GPU specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES changes executable and syntax to `agt mccfg`, assumes read-only behavior and supplies no field-level oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires authority among literal `apt -mccfg`, `agt -mccfg`, `agt mccfg` or separate corrected variant, relation to row227, no-write semantics and complete field/unit/value oracle.

old_problem: Master explicitly says `apt -mccfg`, while package metadata and DeepSeek identify AGT and change syntax. `apt` and `agt` are distinct executable identities, and `mccfg` may configure rather than read state; adjacent row227 is evidence of similarity, not approval to correct a typo.
disposition_reason: Core command identity and operation semantics cannot be parameterized or inferred. ED-03 prohibits guessing OEM commands. Selecting AGT would rewrite the Master, while executing literal apt could invoke unrelated package-manager behavior. Project authority must correct/split the command and define coverage relative to row227.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row230 all18 XLSX cells and history2834.
Preserved literal apt/AGT/syntax conflict and row227 relationship without inferring a typo.
Required vendor no-write semantics and field-level oracle; no command or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GPU memory/configuration information case pending executable and `mccfg` identity
test_case.purpose: After authoritative correction, collect the intended vendor GPU memory/configuration fields through the exact approved executable/mode and compare every required field with the AMD GPU specification without modifying state or duplicating row227.
required_package: Authoritative command identity: literal apt, AGT dash/no-dash syntax, or separately identified corrected variant
Defined relationship and non-duplicate coverage versus row227
Pinned executable/version/checksum and vendor documentation for `mccfg` no-write semantics
Stable GPU UUID/BDF/SKU mapping and recovery if any state interaction exists
test_case.test_command: Do not execute any branch until command identity is approved. Then run only the documented no-write syntax for the pinned executable, retain full output, map every record to stable GPU identity, validate all approved fields/units/values, and prove no configuration change. Do not infer that `apt` means `agt` or that dash/no-dash forms are equivalent.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved command returns every required memory/configuration field for each intended GPU, all values match the project oracle, and no GPU/system state changes or errors occur.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed command correction/identity, vendor-proven no-write semantics, complete field coverage and approved values. A single VRAM number, adjacent-row similarity or alternate syntax cannot pass.
safety_gate: Pin binary checksum/version and stable GPU targets.
Do not invoke package-manager apt with an undocumented vendor option or guess OEM syntax.
Abort on write prompt/state change, schema mismatch or GPU error; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Signed command/variant and row227 relationship decision
Exact command and full raw output
Before/after no-state-change proof plus GPU/kernel/BMC health
test_case.recovery: If any state change is observed, stop, preserve baseline/output/logs and restore only through the vendor-approved procedure with OOB support. Do not guess a reverse command or switch syntax.
